items.original_title: Iran pressed to make nuke concessions as massive post-midterms strikes loom
items.rss_summary: Regional mediators led by Qatar are trying to reach a diplomatic deal to restart negotiations between the U.S. and Iran and prevent the resumption of war after the midterm elections, three U.S., Israeli and regional sources say.The Qataris are working to convince Iran to allow UN inspectors to visit its bombed nuclear sites in return for some sanctions relief from the U.S.  Why it matters: A renewed bombing offensive appears likely shortly after the midterms without a last-minute deal. IDF chief
